purpose: Version contract for factual claims and executable examples. A feature outside the default baseline must use an explicit profile and say so in learner content.

java-17.rule: Use for ordinary Java examples unless the question is explicitly about a feature introduced in another release.

java-8-feature.rule: Use for lambdas, streams, Optional, default methods, and other Java 8 introduction claims. Later behaviour must be checked separately.

java-10-feature.rule: Use for local-variable type inference and label the feature as introduced in Java 10.

java-21-feature.rule: Required for final virtual threads and other Java 21 language or platform features. Never imply that virtual threads are available on Java 17.

spring-boot-3.3.1.rule: Use Spring Boot dependency management for Spring Framework, Spring Data, Spring Security, Jackson, Hibernate, and test-library versions unless a question explicitly pins another version.

spring-managed.rule: Do not invent a transitive framework version. Resolve it from the pinned Spring Boot dependency-management fixture.

validation.mode: compile or integration test through the Spring Boot baseline

jakarta-persistence-3.1.rule: Separate portable Jakarta Persistence behaviour from Hibernate implementation details.

validation.mode: compile or MVC integration test through the Spring Boot baseline

jakarta-validation-3.0.rule: State when validation requires both constraints and a validation trigger such as @Valid.

validation.mode: execute against PostgreSQL 15 or mark the example as parse-only

postgresql-15.rule: Label PostgreSQL-specific syntax and behaviour. Do not present it as portable SQL.

validation.mode: execute against MySQL 8.0 or mark the example as parse-only

mysql-8.0.rule: Use only when the question or comparison explicitly addresses MySQL.

validation.mode: parse complete HTTP request and response transcripts

http-rfc-9110.rule: Use modern HTTP semantics and distinguish normative protocol behaviour from common REST API conventions.

validation.mode: validate XML message structure against the SOAP 1.2 processing model

soap-1.2.rule: Use only for claims or examples explicitly labelled SOAP 1.2; do not generalize the SOAP 1.2 envelope or processing rules to every web service.

validation.mode: record tool --version and execute in an isolated fixture

tool-version-pinned.rule: Required for Git, Maven, Gradle, Docker, and other command output that can change by release.

validation.mode: manual review with guidance clearly labelled

guidance-versionless.rule: Use for recommendations that are not language or product guarantees.

knownRepositoryConflicts.resolution: New evidence uses 3.3.1. Older content is not considered version-verified until its example is rebuilt against the pinned fixture.

observedValues: README associates Java 17+ with virtual threads
knownRepositoryConflicts.resolution: Final virtual threads require the java-21-feature profile. Java 17 content must not claim availability.

reviewRules: Every evidence record lists at least one version profile.
Every version-dependent claim names the exact profile that supports it.
Implementation details identify the implementation and version; they are not described as Java, SQL, or HTTP guarantees.
The reviewed source version and the executable fixture version must agree before a question can be approved.
